title: Asymptotic order of the dimension error
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $s$ be the greatest natural number at most $2^{w+2}$ satisfying $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le 1/2$, define the critical dimension as $ws$, and define its error as $(\log 2)w2^w-ws$. As $w\to\infty$, this error is $\Theta(w)$; that is, it is bounded above and below in magnitude by positive constant multiples of $w$ for all sufficiently large $w$.
hypotheses_covered: The critical size is the greatest qualifying $s\le 2^{w+2}$
